value:
v1.0.0 STABLE SHIPPED 2026-05-07. Reverie launch is live. Post-launch housekeeping pass complete.

REALITY CHECK:
- GitHub release v1.0.0 published (4 binaries: linux x64/arm64, macOS universal, win-x64.exe; rvr-* names ~100-135 MB each).
- Homebrew tap rvr.rb formula installed cleanly. `brew install seabearDEV/reverie/rvr` works.
- Smoke verified end-to-end on stable: --version returns 1.0.0 (clean stdout), MCP probe initialize+tools/list pass with 19 tools, zsh completions parse clean (the #111 fix is in stable).
- The pre-rebrand codexcli-era v1.0.0 release was deleted as part of the cut so v1.0.0 unambiguously refers to the Reverie launch.

VERSION CHANNELS NOW:
- `rvr` (stable, 1.0.0) — Homebrew formula seabearDEV/reverie/rvr
- `rvr-beta` (beta channel, 1.0.0-beta.3) — Homebrew formula seabearDEV/reverie/rvr-beta. Note: rvr-beta is BEHIND stable on the #111 fix; rvr-beta's completion script still emits illegal hyphenated identifiers. Sed-pipe workaround in user .zshrc still required FOR rvr-beta until a beta.4+ ships.
- `rvr-dev` (local dev) — npm-linked from this repo at @seabear/reverie@1.0.0.

POST-LAUNCH HOUSEKEEPING DONE 2026-05-07:
- .mcp.json swapped from rvr-beta to rvr (commit 4b3555d, on origin/main).
- 22 stale tags deleted from origin and local: v0.0.0-debug.0/1, v0.2.1-rc.1/2/3, v1.0.0-beta.0/1/2/3, v1.11.1-beta.0–8 (9), v1.12.2-beta.0/1, plus typo tags v02.2.1-rc.1 and v.0.2.1-rc.1.
- GitHub release set pruned in parallel (external to this session); only v1.0.0, v1.4.0–v1.7.0 remain as Releases.
- Issues #50 ("npx codexcli") and #47 ("ccli diff") retitled to use Reverie/rvr naming, bodies rebranded.
- Reverie + docs audit pass: 18 findings, all remediated (codexcli/ccli residue swept, post-launch state drift corrected, releasePlan replaced with retrospective, bunValidate/bunMigrationScope reframed, _README.md rebranded in-repo).

OPEN WORK (post-launch, USER-DRIVEN):
- Issue #111 workaround in user .zshrc could be dropped by switching the eval line from `rvr-beta config completions zsh` to `rvr config completions zsh` (stable has the fix), OR by cutting beta.4.
- Legacy ccli.rb / ccli-beta.rb formulas still in homebrew-reverie tap — known cleanup item from beta-era handoff. Separate repo, low urgency now that stable rvr exists alongside.
- Short-flag audit (per context.shortFlagAudit) — could ride v1.0.x patch or v1.1.0 minor.
- Phase 4-5 commercial work: SeaBear product page, consulting tier/pricing, Reverie for Teams landing, blog post (bicameral story + codexCLI → Reverie narrative), Dogfooding Part Three.
- Visual identity: logo/wordmark, color palette, marketing site at seabear.dev/reverie.
- Verify `rvr init` produces a Reverie-branded _README.md (this repo's copy was hand-fixed; the binary's template emission has not been re-checked).

DEFERRED to Reverie v1.1+:
- Test-runner swap (vitest → bun:test) — 2-4 days, dominated by vi.mock auto-hoist restructuring across 31 files.
- Web app / visualization layer (mindmap, topology) — pairs with #83.
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators).
- Entry health / staleness work (#84).
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation.

SUPERSEDED (don't run):
- v1.0.0-beta.2 binary (data writes EACCES, MCP non-functional). Anyone on it should brew upgrade rvr-beta (currently 1.0.0-beta.3) or brew install seabearDEV/reverie/rvr (stable).
